problem_text:
A mixture of purple paint contains 6 teaspoons of red paint and 15 teaspoons of blue paint. To make the same shade of purple paint using 35 teaspoons of blue paint, how much red paint would you need? Use the double number line diagram to help if needed.
[Image: A double number line. Each number line has 9 equally spaced tick marks. The top number line is labeled "red paint (teaspoons)" where the first tick mark is labeled 0 and the fourth tick mark is labeled 6. The bottom number line is labeled "blue paint (teaspoons)" where the first tick mark is labeled 0 and the fourth tick mark is labeled 15.]

Answer choices:
A. 12 teaspoons || 14 teaspoons || 18 teaspoons || 26 teaspoons
